title: HXL Order Card
description: A customer's own orders, scoped by Salesforce sharing to the Contact behind the access token. One definition, rendered natively by Agentforce, Slack, ChatGPT and Claude.

customerName.title: Customer Name
customerName.description: Display name of the Contact the access token belongs to.

email.title: Email
email.description: Email of the Contact on the token.

contactId.title: Contact Id
contactId.description: The Contact id read off the token by Apex. Never supplied by the caller.

orderCount.title: Order Count
orderCount.description: How many orders this Contact can see.

totalValue.title: Total Value
totalValue.description: Sum of the visible orders, preformatted for display.

latestOrderNumber.title: Latest Order Number
latestOrderNumber.description: Order number of the most recent order.

latestOrderStatus.title: Latest Order Status
latestOrderStatus.description: Status of the most recent order, such as Submitted or Shipped.

latestOrderAmount.title: Latest Order Amount
latestOrderAmount.description: Amount of the most recent order, preformatted for display.

latestOrderPlaced.title: Latest Order Placed
latestOrderPlaced.description: When the most recent order was placed, preformatted for display.

identityMode.title: Identity Mode
identityMode.description: Whether the data came from a live named-user token or from local sample data.

isLiveIdentity.title: Is Live Identity
isLiveIdentity.description: True when the payload came from a real Headless Identity token rather than sample data.

scopeNote.title: Scope Note
scopeNote.description: Plain-language statement of what Salesforce sharing enforced on this response.
